items.title: 24.4 Evolution from prokaryotes to eukaryotes (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 24.4, printed page 222.

blocks.text: Hum jante hain ke zameen par sab se pehle jandar prokaryotes (baghair nucleus wale saade cells) the. Yeh taqreeban 3.5 billion (350 crore) saal pehle ek bohat ghair mustaqil (unstable) mahol mein organic molecules ke reactions se bane. Taqreeban 2 billion (200 crore) saal pehle prokaryotes se eukaryotes (asal nucleus wale cells) evolve hue. Prokaryotes se eukaryotes banne ke liye “Endosymbiotic Theory” sab se zyada maana hua nazariya hai.

blocks.prompt: Pehle kaun aaye, prokaryotes ya eukaryotes, aur taqreeban kab?
blocks.explanation: Pehle prokaryotes aaye, taqreeban 3.5 billion saal pehle. Eukaryotes un se taqreeban 2 billion saal pehle evolve hue.

items: Pehle jandar prokaryotes: taqreeban 3.5 billion saal pehle, organic molecules ke reactions se.
Eukaryotes: taqreeban 2 billion saal pehle prokaryotes se; sab se maana hua nazariya Endosymbiotic Theory.
